# Adobe character mappings

Pinned AGL and ITC Zapf Dingbats mappings are reformatted by PageNarrator's importer. The runtime reads `mappings.json`; no upstream executable code is included. Dingbats mappings apply only in a verified Dingbats font context.

`manifest.json` records source URLs, hashes, counts, and transformations. Retain `LICENSE.md` when distributing the data.
